name: anthropics/formal-math
title: Anthropic says an internal Claude model found a proof that VP is not equal to VNP, with a 70-page paper and a Lean formalization
summary: Anthropic posted a paper and Lean proof, credited to Claude, claiming Valiant's algebraic analogue of P vs NP (a superpolynomial lower bound for the permanent) over every field. The Lean proof reportedly passes automated checks; it does not settle P vs NP itself.

appearances.title: Anthropic publishes a subexponential 3-SAT algorithm
appearances.summary: Anthropic published a Lean 4 formalization of a deterministic 2^o(n) algorithm for 3-SAT and for counting solutions. The paper says an internal Claude model found the core algorithm on October 16 with no human input, and that researchers then worked with Claude on the write-up.
